sections.title: 1. Scope and contracting parties
paragraphs: These GTC apply to contracts between ELCORIX and consumers for cosmetic laser treatments for hair reduction and for consultation and ancillary services directly related to them.

For treatment packages, appointments and vouchers, the special conditions incorporated at the time the contract is concluded apply in addition. In the event of a conflict, an individually agreed arrangement takes precedence; after that, the more specific provision applies.
ELCORIX does not provide medical diagnosis or medical treatment. If you have complaints or doubts about your health suitability, seek medical advice before the cosmetic application.

sections.title: 2. Offer and conclusion of contract
paragraphs: Service descriptions, price lists and information on the website do not yet constitute a binding contractual offer. A contract is concluded when ELCORIX expressly accepts a booking or order, when an individual agreement is signed, or when the agreed service is begun with the consent of both parties.
Booking a free initial consultation does not yet give rise to a claim to a treatment being carried out or to a contract for a treatment package.

For contracts concluded exclusively by means of distance communication or outside business premises, the client receives the legally required information and – where provided for by law – a cancellation policy.

sections.title: 3. Service, suitability and treatment planning
paragraphs: Laser treatments are carried out only on persons who have reached the age of 18. Consent from legal guardians does not give rise to a claim to treatment of a minor.

Before the first session, the treatment goal, the intended zones, the material risks, contraindications and the necessary instructions on conduct are discussed. Treatment requires an individual suitability assessment and the separately documented consent of the person to be treated.
Sessions are carried out exclusively by professionals who are qualified for this and trained on the specific device used.

ELCORIX may refuse, interrupt or postpone a session if, in its professional judgement, contraindications, safety concerns, insufficient preparation or other circumstances prevent it from being carried out safely. The client's statutory rights remain unaffected.

The suitability and timing of subsequent sessions are determined individually by the practitioner. Particular account is taken of the agreed zones, hair growth, skin reactions, the season, the manufacturer's specifications and the result of the previous session. General time indications are not binding treatment dates and are no guarantee of success. If, despite timely cooperation, a package cannot be completed within its regular term because of the plan professionally set by ELCORIX, the extension rules of the Package Terms apply. Additional sessions are booked only on the basis of a separate agreement.

No particular cosmetic result, particular number of necessary sessions or permanent complete freedom from hair is owed. What is owed is the professional performance of the service agreed in each case.

sections.title: 4. Client's cooperation
paragraphs: The person to be treated answers safety-relevant questions truthfully and completely and informs ELCORIX without delay of any changes, in particular illnesses, medication, pregnancy, skin changes or other possible contraindications.

Pre- and aftercare instructions communicated clearly and in good time must be followed. In the case of lack of preparation, the Appointment Terms apply only if the session therefore cannot be carried out professionally or safely.

sections.title: 5. Prices and payment
paragraphs: The prices agreed at the time the contract is concluded apply. Final prices are stated to consumers. As long as ELCORIX applies the small business scheme under Section 19 of the German VAT Act (UStG), VAT is not shown separately.

Single treatments are due at the latest after the respective session unless otherwise agreed. Treatment packages are paid in full before the first session. Payment by instalments with ELCORIX exists only if it has been expressly agreed individually.

The payment methods offered in the specific booking or payment process are decisive. Set-off by consumers remains permissible with undisputed or legally established claims and with claims arising from the same contractual relationship.

sections.title: 6. Appointments and cancellation costs
paragraphs: The Appointment Terms incorporated at the time the contract is concluded apply to cancellations, rebookings, late arrivals, no-shows and appointments cancelled by the studio.

For a missed session, no additional treatment unit is used up, nor is a second fee charged for the same service in addition to a cancellation claim. Saved expenses, rebooking of the slot and proof of lower or no loss are taken into account in accordance with the Appointment Terms.

sections.title: 7. Treatment packages
paragraphs: Scope, zones, number of sessions, price, regular term and, where applicable, the single price applicable at the time the contract is concluded are recorded in the package agreement. The Package Terms apply in addition.

Crediting of value in the case of an agreed change of zones or a transfer of the remaining package is to be distinguished from the final settlement on termination of the contract. Such a change does not in itself trigger a retrospective conversion of sessions already carried out to single prices. For termination, statutory rights and special refund cases, the relevant provisions of the Package Terms and the statutory provisions apply.

sections.title: 8. Termination of contract and statutory rights
paragraphs: The right of both parties to terminate for good cause and mandatory statutory termination and refund rights remain unaffected. On termination, services already provided, payments, refunds and justified, documented appointment charges are shown in a traceable way.

Where a contract was concluded at a distance or outside business premises and a statutory right of withdrawal exists, the cancellation policy provided and the statutory provisions apply. Cancelling an appointment is not automatically a withdrawal from or termination of the underlying contract.

sections.title: 9. Liability
paragraphs: ELCORIX is liable without limitation for intent and gross negligence, for damage arising from injury to life, body or health, under the German Product Liability Act and in all other cases of mandatory statutory liability.

In the case of a slightly negligent breach of an essential contractual obligation, ELCORIX is liable for the typical, foreseeable damage. Essential contractual obligations are obligations whose fulfilment makes the proper performance of the contract possible in the first place and on whose compliance the other party may regularly rely. Otherwise, liability for slight negligence is excluded to the extent permitted by law.

Contributory fault, in particular because safety-relevant circumstances were not disclosed or were disclosed incorrectly, or because clear pre- and aftercare instructions were not followed, is taken into account in accordance with the statutory provisions.

sections.title: 10. Data protection
paragraphs: Information on the processing of personal data, in particular health data and images, is provided separately. Consent to voluntary promotional photos or videos is not a prerequisite for concluding or carrying out a treatment contract.

sections.title: 11. Consumer dispute resolution
paragraphs: ELCORIX is not obliged and currently not willing to participate in dispute resolution proceedings before a consumer arbitration board.

sections.title: 12. Applicable law
paragraphs: German law applies. For consumers habitually resident in another country, the mandatory protective provisions of that country remain unaffected. Statutory places of jurisdiction remain unaffected.
Each contract is governed by the version of these GTC incorporated at the time it was concluded. Changes to a contract already concluded require an agreement between the parties.

lead: ELCORIX · consultation and cosmetic laser treatments

sections.title: 1. Scope
paragraphs: These conditions apply to agreed consultation and treatment appointments. They supplement the respective contract and the ELCORIX GTC.

sections.title: 2. Cancellation and rebooking
paragraphs: An appointment can be cancelled or rebooked free of charge up to 24 hours before its agreed start. What counts is the verifiable receipt of the notice by ELCORIX.

Notice can be given by email to info@elcorix.de, via a booking function enabled in the appointment confirmation or via the WhatsApp Business contact stated there. Notice by telephone is sufficient if it is taken by ELCORIX or recorded on a voicemail provided for this purpose.

sections.title: 3. Short-notice cancellation
paragraphs: For a cancellation less than 24 hours before the start of the appointment, ELCORIX may charge 50% of the treatment price agreed for the reserved appointment as flat-rate compensation. For a package treatment, the maximum is 50% of the calculated package price of one session.

The flat rate does not apply to the extent that ELCORIX gives the appointment to someone else. The client is expressly permitted to prove that no loss or a significantly lower loss was incurred. ELCORIX reserves the right to prove a higher loss actually incurred, to the extent permitted by law.

sections.title: 4. No-show
paragraphs: In the event of a no-show without timely cancellation, ELCORIX may claim the loss recoverable under the statutory provisions, but no more than the treatment price agreed for the reserved appointment; for a package treatment, no more than the calculated package price of one session. Saved expenses and income from rebooking the slot are credited.
The client is expressly permitted to prove that no loss or a significantly lower loss was incurred. A missed package treatment is not additionally deducted as a session carried out.

sections.title: 5. Unforeseeable exceptional cases
paragraphs: In the event of an unforeseeable acute illness, an accident or a comparable family emergency, no cancellation claim is made if ELCORIX is informed without delay. For a first occurrence, a plausible notice is generally sufficient. For repeated occurrences, ELCORIX may request reasonable evidence; it does not have to reveal a diagnosis.

sections.title: 6. Late arrival
paragraphs: If you are up to ten minutes late, treatment will be carried out where possible; the treatment may be shortened by the time of the delay, provided this is professionally sensible and safe.

If the session can no longer be carried out safely or sensibly because of a longer delay, the rules for a short-notice cancellation under section 3 generally apply, not automatically the rules for a no-show. There is no right to an extension of the reserved time slot.

sections.title: 7. Lack of preparation
paragraphs: If a session cannot be carried out safely or professionally because preparation instructions communicated clearly and in good time were not followed, the rules for a short-notice cancellation under section 3 generally apply. This does not apply if the instruction was unclear, was given too late, or the cause was not foreseeable and not avoidable for the client.

sections.title: 8. Free initial consultation
paragraphs: The first initial consultation is free of charge. After an unexcused no-show, ELCORIX may require a security deposit of EUR 25.00 for a further free consultation appointment.

The security deposit is repaid in full if the appointment is attended, even if no treatment contract is concluded. Only at the client's express request can it be credited against a later purchase price. In the event of another short-notice cancellation or another no-show, ELCORIX may only set it off against a claim justified under these Appointment Terms and the statutory provisions.

sections.title: 9. Cancellation by ELCORIX
paragraphs: If ELCORIX has to cancel an appointment, a replacement appointment is offered. If a replacement service is not possible or not reasonable, payments made for the missed service are refunded. For treatment packages, no session is deducted; the term is extended by the actual delay caused by ELCORIX. Further statutory claims remain unaffected.

sections.title: 10. Future bookings
paragraphs: After repeated short-notice cancellations or no-shows, ELCORIX may make future appointments conditional on a reasonable prepayment or on the settlement of due, justified claims. Each cancellation claim is reviewed and documented individually.

preamble: These Package Terms supplement the ELCORIX GTC. The specific package agreement and individually agreed arrangements take precedence.

sections.title: 1. Subject of the package
paragraphs: A treatment package covers the zones named in the package agreement and either six or eight sessions. The person to be treated, the package price, the package tier, the single price at the time the contract is concluded and the regular term are documented there.
The package must be paid in full in advance. It does not give rise to a claim to sessions that are not professionally indicated or cannot be carried out safely.

sections.title: 2. Individual treatment plan
paragraphs: The practitioner determines the appropriate timing of the sessions individually. Decisive factors are in particular the zones, hair growth, skin reaction, season, the manufacturer's specifications and the result of the previous session. General interval indications are non-binding guideline values.
The client cooperates in scheduling in good time. After each session, ELCORIX documents the recommended time window for the next appointment.

sections.title: 3. Term, justified extension and completion
paragraphs: 3.1 The regular package term is twelve months from full payment of the package price. A paid extension does not take place automatically.

3.2 In the event of a temporary, plausibly demonstrated medical impediment – including pregnancy – the term is extended once by its actual duration, but by no more than twelve months. The regular term and this client-related extension may not exceed 24 months in total. Reason and duration are documented only to the extent necessary; health details belong exclusively in the protected client records. In the case of permanent unsuitability, section 5.3 applies.

3.3 Delays for which ELCORIX is responsible extend the term by their actual duration; this extension does not count towards the maximum under 3.2. If, despite timely cooperation, the package cannot be completed within the applicable term solely because of the treatment intervals professionally set by ELCORIX, the term is extended until the next possible professionally justifiable appointments.

3.4 Holidays, work-related or private commitments, forgotten bookings, appointments cancelled by the client and no-shows do not, as a rule, extend the term. Statutory rights and proven exceptional circumstances remain unaffected.

3.5 Where possible, ELCORIX sends a reminder in text form eight and four weeks before the end of the applicable term. Irrespective of this, the client remains responsible for scheduling appointments in good time.

3.6 If sessions are still outstanding when the applicable term expires, ELCORIX requests the client in text form, stating the exact end date and the possible consequences, to schedule appointments or to notify a recognisable reason for extension within 30 calendar days. Later appointments already bindingly agreed and statutory rights remain unaffected. A technical failure of a non-binding reminder does not replace the verifiable receipt of this final request.

3.7 If neither the required cooperation nor notification of a recognisable reason takes place within this grace period, the entitlement to further package treatments ends. ELCORIX confirms the completion in text form and prepares a final settlement in accordance with section 5.2. The prepayment is not forfeited merely by the passage of time.

sections.title: 4. Change of zones and transfer
paragraphs: 4.1 A change of zones or package content requires an agreement with ELCORIX in text form. There is no unilateral right to a one-to-one swap.

4.2 The unused remainder may be transferred once and only in full to another adult person who is professionally suitable. The request must be received no later than the end of the applicable term or of the grace period under 3.6; the transfer becomes effective only upon confirmation by ELCORIX in text form. Splitting among several persons or into individual sessions is excluded. When the transfer becomes effective, the previously entitled person loses the right to use the transferred remainder.

4.3 If the package, zones and objective scope of service remain unchanged, the remaining sessions are continued on the existing contractual terms. The gender of the person taking over does not in itself justify either a surcharge or a discount; what matters is the zones actually agreed and the objective scope of service.

4.4 If zones or package content are changed, for a fully paid package of the same structure the transferable remaining value is calculated as follows: remaining value R = package price paid P × (agreed number N − sessions actually carried out k) ÷ agreed number N. Sessions already carried out are not retrospectively converted to single prices for this change. Refunds, earlier changes and justified appointment claims are shown separately and are not taken into account twice. A missed appointment is not a session carried out.

4.5 The package tier current at the time of the change applies to the newly chosen service: for an original 6-session package, the comparison price of the current 6-session package is used; for an original 8-session package, the comparison price of the current 8-session package. The total price of the comparison package is divided by six or eight respectively and multiplied by the newly agreed number of sessions. No additional package discount is applied. If the new service is more expensive, the agreed difference must be paid before it is carried out. If it is cheaper, the difference is documented as a personal credit of the person taking over; the change of zones or the transfer alone does not trigger an automatic payout.

4.6 Final amounts are rounded to the cent; intermediate values are not rounded. A change of zones or a transfer does not start a new term. The existing term, including documented extensions and a running grace period, remains in place.

4.7 The person taking over undergoes their own consultation and suitability assessment, receives their own client records and makes the required declarations. Health data, treatment records and images of the previously entitled person are not transferred.

4.8 These provisions concern the contractually agreed transfer of the package services. The legally permissible assignment of monetary claims is neither excluded nor made subject to the consent of ELCORIX. For a later contractual repayment, the person who originally paid is, as a rule, recorded as the payee, unless all persons concerned agree a different payment instruction in text form or an effective assignment or statutory provision is decisive. An additional top-up payment and its repayment recipient are recorded separately. The personal repurchase right under section 7 is not transferred.

sections.title: 5. Early termination and final settlement
paragraphs: 5.1 Statutory rights of withdrawal, termination and rescission and the right to terminate for good cause remain unaffected.

5.2 If the client wishes, for personal reasons, an early termination by mutual agreement without a case under 5.3 or a mandatory statutory right applying, the sessions actually carried out are charged at the single prices documented in the package agreement as at the time of purchase. Any positive amount remaining is repaid on request or kept as credit. If the calculation does not produce a positive amount, no additional payment is demanded.

5.3 If the package is terminated because the treatment goal has already been achieved, because of permanent medical unsuitability or because of a permanent impossibility for which ELCORIX is responsible, the sessions not yet carried out are refunded pro rata based on the package price paid. Mandatory statutory claims may go further.

5.4 Justified and documented claims under the Appointment Terms are shown separately and taken into account only under the statutory conditions. An appointment charge already taken into account is not deducted again. For the final settlement, the sessions actually provided, the single prices agreed at the time of purchase and payments and refunds already made are documented separately.

sections.title: 6. Appointments within the package
paragraphs: The Appointment Terms apply to appointment cancellations and no-shows. A justified cancellation claim is documented separately from the number of sessions actually carried out. A missed session is not deemed used up merely because of the cancellation claim.

sections.title: 7. Repurchase of individual follow-up treatments
paragraphs: After a 6- or 8-session package has been used in full, the same treated person may, within six months of the last package treatment, purchase individual follow-up treatments for the same zones at the calculated per-session price of the originally agreed package tier. The documented package price is decisive; further discounts are not cumulated. The right is personal, not transferable and subject to continued professional suitability.

sections.title: 8. Relationship to individual agreements
paragraphs: The package agreement documents the individual key data. Later changes and extensions are recorded in text form. Individual agreements and mandatory statutory provisions take precedence over these Package Terms.

sections.title: 2. General information
paragraphs: We process personal data only insofar as this is necessary to provide this website, to handle enquiries, to prepare or perform contracts, to comply with legal obligations or to safeguard legitimate interests, or where you have given your consent.
Personal data is any information relating to an identified or identifiable person, for example a name, contact details or an IP address.

sections.title: 3. Hosting and server log data
paragraphs: This website and the associated database are hosted by the following provider:

Hetzner Online GmbH
Industriestr. 25

Germany
When the website is accessed, the server processes technically necessary log data. This may include in particular:

list: IP address;
date and time of access;
page or file accessed;
amount of data transferred;
referrer URL;
browser type and browser version;
operating system;
access status or HTTP status code.

paragraphs: This processing takes place in order to provide the website technically, to ensure its stability and security and to be able to detect and fend off misuse or attacks. The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR. Our legitimate interest lies in a secure and functioning website.

Regular server log data is deleted after seven days at the latest. Data required to investigate a specific security incident may be stored until the investigation has been completed and, where applicable, beyond that for the establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims.

Hetzner processes data on our behalf on the basis of a contract pursuant to Art. 28 GDPR. The servers we use are located in Germany. Further information is provided by Hetzner at https://www.hetzner.com/legal/privacy-policy/.

sections.title: 4. Contact form
paragraphs: If you use the contact form, we process the data you enter:

list: name;
e-mail address;
content of your message.

paragraphs: We use this data exclusively to handle your enquiry and to communicate with you. If the enquiry relates to a possible contract or treatment, the processing is based on Art. 6 (1) (b) GDPR. For other enquiries, the legal basis is Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR; our legitimate interest lies in answering the enquiry properly.

sections.title: 5. Consultation request
paragraphs: For a consultation request via the website, we process:

list: name;
country code and phone number;
preferred day and preferred time, if provided.

paragraphs: The processing serves to contact you, arrange an appointment and prepare a possible service. The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) (b) GDPR.

Please do not submit health data, treatment photos or other particularly sensitive information via the website forms. If such information is required for a treatment, we will collect it later through channels intended and secured for this purpose.

sections.title: 6. Storage and transmission of form requests
paragraphs: Requests from the contact and consultation forms are stored in a PostgreSQL database operated at Hetzner. In addition, they are forwarded via the mail server of the hosting environment to our business e-mail inbox. Only persons who need to handle the request for ELCORIX have access.

Form requests are generally deleted no later than six months after their final handling. If a contractual relationship arises from the request, the necessary data may be stored for longer, for the duration of that contractual relationship and in accordance with the statutory retention periods. In this case, the legal bases are Art. 6 (1) (b) and (c) GDPR.

Backups are created on a rolling basis and overwritten after 14 days at the latest. Data already scheduled for deletion may still be contained in a backup until then. Backups are used only for restoration after a technical or security-related incident.

Personal content from form requests is not transmitted to Telegram. A purely technical notification without name, phone number, e-mail address, preferred appointment or message content may be used to alert our team to a new request in the protected system.

sections.title: 7. Protection against abusive form requests
paragraphs: To protect the forms, we use an input field invisible to users (honeypot) and technical limits on the frequency of requests (rate limiting). In particular, the IP address and technical time information may be processed temporarily. The processing is based on Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR. Our legitimate interest lies in protecting the website and our systems against automated requests, spam and misuse.
We do not use Google reCAPTCHA or any comparable external captcha service for this.

sections.title: 8. Contact by e-mail or phone
paragraphs: If you contact us by e-mail or phone, we process your contact details and the content of your communication in order to handle the enquiry. The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) (b) GDPR insofar as the preparation or performance of a contract is concerned, and otherwise Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR. Our legitimate interest lies in handling and documenting business enquiries.
The data is deleted as soon as it is no longer required for handling the enquiry and there are no statutory retention obligations or legitimate reasons for further storage.

sections.title: 9. Voluntary consent to promotional contact
paragraphs: If you expressly and voluntarily allow us to contact you about offers or news, we use the contact details you have released for this purpose only for this purpose. The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) (a) GDPR in conjunction with the relevant provisions of competition law.

Consent is voluntary and is not a prerequisite for a consultation request or treatment. You can withdraw it at any time with effect for the future, for example by e-mail to info@elcorix.de. The lawfulness of the processing carried out until the withdrawal remains unaffected.

sections.title: 10. Local storage and technically necessary settings
paragraphs: Our website uses your browser's local storage for the following functional settings:

list: i18nextLng, to store the language you have chosen;

list.text: cookie-consent, to store your choice regarding the privacy settings.

paragraphs: This information is necessary to provide the website function you have requested or your privacy choice. Storing or reading takes place on the basis of § 25 (2) no. 2 TDDDG. Insofar as personal data is processed in the process, the legal basis is Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR; with regard to documenting consent, also Art. 6 (1) (c) GDPR.

We currently do not use Google Fonts, Google reCAPTCHA or an external content delivery network. Google Analytics and the Meta Pixel are currently not activated. The Altegio booking system is currently not loaded either.

sections.title: 11. Audience measurement with Umami
paragraphs: To learn how our website is used and how visitors find us – for example via Instagram, search engines or individual promotions – we use the open-source software Umami. We run Umami ourselves on our server at Hetzner in Germany (see section 3). The data is passed on neither to the maker of Umami nor to any other third party.
Umami sets no cookies and stores no information on your device. With every page view and the interactions listed below, the following data is processed:

list: the page viewed, its title and the time;
campaign parameters in the address (for example utm_source or utm_campaign) and click identifiers of advertising platforms (for example gclid or fbclid), if the address contains them;
the referrer URL, i.e. the page you came to us from;
browser, operating system, device type, screen size and language setting;
approximate location (country, region, city), derived from the IP address;

interactions without their content: successfully submitting the consultation or contact form, and tapping the phone number, the e-mail address, the WhatsApp or the Instagram link, each with the part of the page the link is in.

paragraphs: Your IP address is not stored. Together with your browser identifier (user agent) and a secret value that changes daily, it is turned into an irreversible identifier that groups the page views of one day. There is no recognition on later days, no cross-site profiling and no combination with what you enter in our forms. We only evaluate the data in aggregate and do not try to identify individual people.

The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR. Our legitimate interest lies in statistically evaluating the use of our website, measuring the effectiveness of our advertising and improving the website and our services.
The data is deleted automatically after 14 months at the latest. It may remain in backups for up to 14 days longer (see section 6).

You can object to the audience measurement at any time: if your browser sends the “Global Privacy Control” or “Do Not Track” signal, Umami is not loaded. Likewise, no data is collected if you disable JavaScript or use a content blocker.

sections.title: 12. OpenStreetMap
paragraphs: To show our location, we embed a map from OpenStreetMap via a so-called iFrame. The provider is:

OpenStreetMap Foundation
St John’s Innovation Centre
Cowley Road
Cambridge CB4 0WS
United Kingdom

The map is loaded directly from OpenStreetMap when the page in question is opened. For technical reasons, OpenStreetMap thereby receives in particular your IP address as well as information about your browser and device, operating system, referring website, date and time of access and the content retrieved. OpenStreetMap may deliver map data via a worldwide network of cache servers.

The embedding is based on Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR. Our legitimate interest lies in showing our location clearly and making it easier to find us. The United Kingdom has an adequacy decision of the European Commission. When the worldwide cache network is used, data may also be processed in other countries.
Further information can be found in the privacy policy of the OpenStreetMap Foundation: https://osmfoundation.org/wiki/Privacy_Policy.

sections.title: 13. WhatsApp link
paragraphs: Our website contains a link that lets you start a conversation on WhatsApp. As long as you do not click the link, no connection to WhatsApp is established merely because of this link.

If you click the link or write to us via WhatsApp, you are forwarded to the WhatsApp service. WhatsApp processes, among other things, your IP address and other technical data. If you send us a message, we receive and process in particular your phone number, where applicable your profile name, the content of the message and communication and time data.
The provider for users in the European Economic Area is:

WhatsApp Ireland Limited
Merrion Road

We process your message in order to handle your enquiry. The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) (b) GDPR insofar as the communication serves the preparation or performance of a contract, and otherwise Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR. Our legitimate interest lies in fast and user-friendly communication.

Using WhatsApp is voluntary. You can contact us by e-mail or phone instead. Please do not send us health data or treatment photos via WhatsApp. We do not have full influence over the independent processing by WhatsApp. Further information can be found at https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/privacy-policy-eea.

sections.title: 14. Instagram link
paragraphs: Our website merely contains an external link to our Instagram presence. As long as you do not click the link, no connection to Instagram is established via this link.

After clicking, you leave our website. Instagram or Meta then processes data about your access and your further use under its own responsibility. The provider for users in the European Economic Area is Meta Platforms Ireland Limited, Merrion Road, Dublin 4, D04 X2K5, Ireland.
Further information on data processing at Instagram can be found at https://privacycenter.instagram.com/policy/.

sections.title: 15. Recipients of personal data
paragraphs: Within ELCORIX, only those persons who need personal data to handle the respective enquiry have access to it. In addition, data may be transferred to the extent necessary to the following categories of recipients:

list: hosting and IT service providers;
providers of the business e-mail inbox and e-mail transmission;
communication services, if you use them yourself to contact us;
tax advisers, legal advisers or authorities, insofar as this is required by law or serves the establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims.

paragraphs: Insofar as service providers process data on our behalf, they are contractually bound in accordance with Art. 28 GDPR.

sections.title: 16. Transfers to third countries
paragraphs: Personal data is transferred to a country outside the European Union or the European Economic Area only if the requirements of Art. 44 et seq. GDPR are met. This may take place in particular on the basis of an adequacy decision of the European Commission or appropriate safeguards such as the standard contractual clauses of the European Commission.

When external services such as WhatsApp or Instagram are accessed, the respective providers may also process data in third countries. Details can be found in the privacy notices of the respective providers.

sections.title: 17. Your rights
paragraphs: Subject to the statutory requirements, you have in particular the following rights:

list: access to the personal data processed by us pursuant to Art. 15 GDPR;
rectification of inaccurate or completion of incomplete data pursuant to Art. 16 GDPR;
erasure pursuant to Art. 17 GDPR;
restriction of processing pursuant to Art. 18 GDPR;
data portability pursuant to Art. 20 GDPR;
objection to processing pursuant to Art. 21 GDPR;
withdrawal of consent given, with effect for the future, pursuant to Art. 7 (3) GDPR.

paragraphs: To exercise your rights, you can contact info@elcorix.de.

Insofar as we process personal data on the basis of Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR, you may object to this processing at any time on grounds relating to your particular situation. We will then no longer process the data concerned unless we can demonstrate compelling legitimate grounds that override your interests, rights and freedoms, or the processing serves the establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims.

sections.title: 18. Right to lodge a complaint
paragraphs: You have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority. For non-public companies based in Bavaria, the competent authority is in particular:

Bayerisches Landesamt für Datenschutzaufsicht (BayLDA)
https://www.lda.bayern.de/
You may also contact another supervisory authority competent under Art. 77 GDPR.

sections.title: 19. No automated decision-making
paragraphs: Solely automated decision-making, including profiling within the meaning of Art. 22 GDPR, does not take place.

sections.title: 20. Updates to this privacy policy
paragraphs: We amend this privacy policy when the website, the services used or the legal requirements change. The current version is always available on this website.
